newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Tekstina to be listed on OTC on Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Tekstina to be listed on OTC on Feb 12.

text.p: Slovenia's textile company Tekstina will list its shares on the over-the-counter (OTC) market of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange on February 12, the bourse said on Tuesday.
The company will list 826,682 shares with a nominal value of 1,000 tolars each, representing 55 percent of the firm's equity.
From February 16 another 585,804 of Tekstina's shares will be listed on the OTC, taking its total listed equity to 94 percent.

The shares due to be listed on February 16 were sold to employees of the company during Tekstina's privatisation and according to Slovenian regulations could not be traded for two years after their issue date of February 16, 1995.
Tekstina will join a group of 27 newly privatised companies that have been listed on the main or OTC markets of the Ljubljana bourse since January 1996.
Currently 25 shares are traded on the main market and 30 on the OTC segment of the bourse.
